extDescription.message: Stops ClickFix and fake CAPTCHA attacks that trick you into running commands, and warns about sites reported as malicious.

alertClipboardBody.message: This page tried to put a hidden command in your clipboard. Sites that ask you to paste something into Run, Terminal or File Explorer to prove you are human or to fix an error are a scam called ClickFix, and your clipboard now holds a harmless note instead.

alertManualBody.message: The text you tried to copy runs a hidden command on your computer, so a harmless note was copied instead. Never paste commands from a website into Run, Terminal or File Explorer.

alertPasteBody.message: You were about to paste a sign-in link with a secret code into this page, which can hand over your account. Real sign-in pages never ask you to do this.

alertProtocolTitle.message: Link to a program on your computer blocked

alertProtocolBody.message: This page tried to open a program outside the browser, a trick used to run commands without you noticing.

alertFullscreenBody.message: This page tried to take over your screen like a fake Windows update. Press Esc if anything still covers the screen, then close the tab.

overlayLeaveTip.message: Closes this page and opens a new tab

overlayCloseTip.message: Hides this warning and stays on the page

overlayTrustTip.message: Stops all checks on this site, only use it for sites you know well

overlayHoldTip.message: Hold the button for three seconds to copy the original text, only do this if you fully trust it

bannerReputation.message: This site is reported as malicious in public threat databases

bannerPageInstructions.message: This page tells you to paste something into Run, Terminal or File Explorer, real websites never ask you to do that

bannerWeb3.message: This site loads hidden code from a blockchain

bannerWeb3Detail.message: Hacked websites use this trick to show fake CAPTCHA pages, do not follow any instructions to paste or run commands

warnBody.message: This site is listed in public threat databases as a ClickFix page, it tries to trick visitors into running a command that installs malware.

warnAdvice.message: Never paste anything a website gives you into Run, Terminal or File Explorer.

warnLeaveTip.message: Opens a new tab instead of this site

warnContinueTip.message: Opens the site for the next hour, only do this if you are sure the report is wrong

r_page_win_r.message: The page tells you to press Win and R

r_page_win_x.message: The page tells you to open the Win and X menu or Terminal

r_page_mac_terminal.message: The page tells you to open Terminal with Cmd and Space

r_page_open_terminal.message: The page tells you to open Terminal

r_page_filefix.message: The page tells you to paste into the File Explorer address bar

r_page_paste.message: The page tells you to press Ctrl and V

r_page_enter.message: The page tells you to press Enter

r_page_run_dialog.message: The page mentions the Run dialog

r_page_verify_human.message: The page asks you to prove you are human

r_page_fake_update.message: The page pretends to install updates

r_page_fix.message: The page offers a fix for an error

r_trigger_captcha.message: The command was copied when you clicked a CAPTCHA box

r_trigger_fix.message: The command was copied when you clicked a fix button

r_page_reported.message: The site is reported in public threat databases

r_page_web3.message: The site loads hidden code from a blockchain

r_payload_reported.message: The command downloads from an address reported as malicious

r_consentfix.message: The pasted link carries a sign-in code for your account

welcomeBody.message: ClickFix Warden now watches for pages that try to trick you into running commands, and warns you about sites reported as malicious.

welcomePrivacy.message: Everything is checked inside your browser, nothing about your browsing is sent anywhere.

welcomeHostAccess.message: ClickFix Warden needs access to all websites to protect them.

tipGrantHosts.message: Lets ClickFix Warden watch every page for ClickFix tricks

managedNote.message: Some settings are managed by your organisation.

protectionLead.message: Choose what ClickFix Warden watches for.

tipEnabled.message: Turns every check on or off at once

setClipboard.message: Block dangerous commands in the clipboard

tipClipboard.message: Stops pages from putting a hidden command in your clipboard and puts a harmless note there instead

setPaste.message: Block pasting sign-in links into websites

tipPaste.message: Stops you from pasting a sign-in link that carries a secret code into a page that could steal your account

setProtocols.message: Block links that open programs on your computer

tipProtocols.message: Stops pages from opening Script Editor, Windows search on remote folders and similar programs

tipFullscreen.message: Stops pages that tell you to paste commands from locking the screen with a fake update

setPageWarnings.message: Warn about pages with paste instructions

tipPageWarnings.message: Shows a warning bar when a page tells you to paste something into Run, Terminal or File Explorer

setWeb3.message: Watch for code loaded from a blockchain

tipWeb3.message: Warns when a normal website pulls hidden code from a blockchain, a trick used by hacked sites

tipReputation.message: Shows a warning bar on sites listed as malicious in public threat databases

setBlockPage.message: Block known ClickFix sites before they load

tipBlockPage.message: Shows a full-page warning instead of a site that the databases list as a ClickFix page

tipFeedUpdates.message: Downloads the signed list of reported sites and the newest detection rules every hour

trustedLead.message: ClickFix Warden does not check sites you trust, only add sites you know well.

tipTrustedAdd.message: Adds the site to the list of sites that are not checked

tipTrust.message: Stops all checks on this site

orgLead.message: Extra text shown in every warning, for example who to contact in your company.

orgPlaceholder.message: For example, call the IT helpdesk before you continue

tipOrgSave.message: Saves the text shown in every warning

historyLead.message: Check whether you visited any site that is now listed in the database, the check runs only in your browser.

tipHistoryScan.message: Asks for access to your history and compares it with the database inside your browser

historyChecked.message: Checked $1 addresses from the last $2 days.

historyAdvice.message: If you ran anything a listed site told you to, change your passwords from another device and have this computer checked.

tipHistoryDrop.message: Gives back the history permission until you check again

tipExport.message: Saves the results as a JSON file on this computer

tipExportLog.message: Saves the log as a JSON file on this computer

extensionsLead.message: Look for installed browser extensions that are known to be malicious, such as fake ad blockers used in CrashFix attacks.

tipExtensionsScan.message: Asks for permission to list your extensions and compares them with a list of known malicious ones

tipExtensionsDrop.message: Gives back the permission to list your extensions

tipExtensionsRemove.message: Uninstalls this extension after you confirm

logLead.message: What ClickFix Warden blocked or warned about, the log stays on this computer.

tipLogClear.message: Deletes every entry in the log

logClearConfirm.message: Delete every entry in the detection log?

databaseLead.message: Reports come from the public abuse.ch databases and are checked against a digital signature before use.

tipUpdateNow.message: Downloads the newest database and rules right now

aboutPrivacy.message: ClickFix Warden collects no data, it has no account, no telemetry and no server of its own.

aboutNetwork.message: The only thing it downloads is the signed database and rules from GitHub, which sees the same request any update makes.
